intended_behavior: Extend the BeforeInvocationEvent dataclass to include a messages attribute that holds the input messages passed to the agent during invocation. This enables hooks to access and modify messages early in the invocation lifecycle.

Modify the method to construct the combined input messages (temp_messages) before raising BeforeInvocationEvent. Then raise BeforeInvocationEvent with both agent=self and messages=temp_messages, allowing hooks to inspect or redact messages before proceeding with the invocation. Preserve existing error handling, tracing, and AfterInvocationEvent raising.
